description: Player 1 deck for spec 30 (R384, R510). This is spec 03 player 1 deck (03-plays-a) with #28 Knockoff Temu Glowy Jelly Bean swapped for C #81 The Power to Thrive, and #91 Fed Fauci swapped for C #21 Turtinator. Thrive costs 2 and Turtinator 2, and #8 Mr. Vanilla (1 mana, 4/4) is the Unit that pays Turtinator Tribute. Nothing else here has an Activate ability, a Trap, a Cast-on-draw or a Quickdraw, so the only Activate controls on the board are the two this spec asserts.
